newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka police arrest Tamil hit-squad suspect.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka police arrest Tamil hit-squad suspect.

text.p: Sri Lankan police have arrested a suspected member of a Tamil Tiger rebel hit squad believed to have been planned to kill prominent politicians in the capital Colombo, police said on Monday.
The 26-year-old rebel suspect was identified as S. Ravishankar. He was detained late on Sunday during a routine police search in the eastern port town of Trincomalee, police said.
Ravishankar was suspected of being an accomplice of a woman suicide bomber who killed herself to avoid arrest at a checkpoint in Colombo last week, police said.
Many Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels wear cyanide suicide capsules around their necks to avoid being captured alive.
Police are looking for three other women Tamil rebel suicide bombers said to have come into Colombo, police officials said.
Police declined to say who the rebel targets were.
The government has tightened security in the capital ahead of Tuesday's Independence Day celebrations after intelligence reports of possible rebel attacks.
The rebels are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in the mainly Sinhalese country's north and east.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the ethnic war, now in its 14th year.
